document_api_meta.title: Get Available Review Decisions

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: seller_id
request_query_param.desc: The unique identifier of the seller/shop

request_query_param.name: return_or_cancel_id
request_query_param.desc: The identifier of the aftersales request to evaluate. Pass a reverse main order ID, aftersales request ID, or return merchandise authorization (RMA) ID; the API detects which type was provided. Do not pass an order ID or order line ID.

request_query_param.name: locale
request_query_param.desc:
The BCP-47 locale codes for displaying the return reason, delimited by commas. Default: en-US
Refer to [Locale codes](678e3a47bae28f030a8c7523) for the list of supported locale codes.

request_query_param.name: check_decisions
request_query_param.desc:
The seller decisions to evaluate for the specified aftersales request. Possible values:
- `APPROVE_REQUEST_CANCEL`
- `APPROVE_REFUND`
- `APPROVE_RETURN`
- `APPROVE_RECEIVED_PACKAGE`
- `APPROVE_REPLACEMENT`
- `ISSUE_REPLACEMENT_REFUND`
- `DIRECT_REFUND`
- `REJECT_REQUEST_CANCEL`
- `REJECT_REFUND`
- `REJECT_RETURN`
- `REJECT_RECEIVED_PACKAGE`
- `REJECT_REPLACEMENT`
- `ISSUE_EXCHANGE_REFUND`
- `OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND`
- `OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG`
**Note:** When omitted, the API evaluates all supported seller decisions for the request and returns one result per decision.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: request_id
response_param.desc: Request log

response_param.name: data
response_param.desc: Specific return information

response_param.name: ^line_items
response_param.desc: Line items to which the returned decisions apply. Decision details apply to each line item individually. For example, a partial refund amount of 1.00 for each of three line items results in a total of 3.00; use the `currency` returned with the amount range rather than assuming a currency.

response_param.name: ^^return_line_item_id
response_param.desc: Unique identifier for this item in the return. In the case of virtual bundle, this corresponds to the id of the original parent item bundle.

response_param.name: ^^sub_return_line_item_id
response_param.desc: Unique identifier for this item in the return. In the case of virtual bundle, this corresponds to the id of the current child item being returned.

response_param.name: ^^decisions
response_param.desc: The list of candidate review decisions for this line item.

response_param.name: ^^^decision
response_param.desc:
Seller review decision evaluated for this line item.
Possible values:
- `APPROVE_REQUEST_CANCEL`
- `APPROVE_REFUND`
- `APPROVE_RETURN`
- `APPROVE_RECEIVED_PACKAGE`
- `APPROVE_REPLACEMENT`
- `ISSUE_REPLACEMENT_REFUND`
- `DIRECT_REFUND`
- `REJECT_REQUEST_CANCEL`
- `REJECT_REFUND`
- `REJECT_RETURN`
- `REJECT_RECEIVED_PACKAGE`
- `REJECT_REPLACEMENT`
- `ISSUE_EXCHANGE_REFUND`
- `OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND`
- `OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG`

response_param.name: ^^^eligible
response_param.desc: Whether this decision is currently eligible for the line item. When `false`, `ineligible_code` and `ineligible_reason` explain why the decision is ineligible; these fields are omitted when `true`.

response_param.name: ^^^ineligible_code
response_param.desc: The reason code for an ineligible decision.

response_param.name: ^^^ineligible_reason
response_param.example: the return is already completed, you can't approve again.
response_param.desc: The reason for an ineligible decision.

response_param.name: ^^^available_reject_reasons
response_param.desc: Rejection reasons, if available, for this eligible decision. Each item contains a machine-readable name and display text.

response_param.name: ^^^^name
response_param.desc: The machine-readable name of the rejection reason to pass as the rejection-reason identifier in the applicable review or reject request.

response_param.name: ^^^^text
response_param.example: The display text for the reject reason.
response_param.desc: The display text for the rejection reason.

response_param.name: ^^^partial_refund_amount_range
response_param.desc: The allowed partial refund amount band. Returned for the `OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG` decision when it is eligible; omitted for all other decisions.

response_param.name: ^^^^min_amount
response_param.desc: The minimum partial refund amount the seller may offer.

response_param.name: ^^^^max_amount
response_param.desc: The maximum partial refund amount the seller may offer.

response_param.name: ^^^^currency
response_param.desc: The currency of the partial refund amount range, matching the currency of the current return request.

response_param.name: ^request_log_id
response_param.desc: The log id of this request, used for troubleshooting with TikTok Shop support.

response_param.name: ^errors
response_param.desc:
Lists errors for partially failed requests. For example, if a request reviews multiple orders or items and only some fail, individual error details are returned here.
**IMPORTANT**: Partial failures still return a top-level success code (0), so clients must also check this field to detect partial errors. For complete failures (e.g. validation errors), the top-level response code and message will indicate a failure, but this field will remain empty.

response_param.name: ^^code
response_param.desc: Error Code

response_param.name: ^^message
response_param.example: Invalid parameters. Please verify your input before retrying
response_param.desc: Error Description

error_code_list.msg: reverse amount not support partial refund
partial refund only support single sku
request has been transferred to platform operator
